# Compassion fatigue

## Summary

The English Wikipedia article on compassion fatigue, described in the lead as a developing concept from traumatology, often used interchangeably with secondary traumatic stress and sometimes summed up as the cost of caring. The lead notes that recent work draws some distinctions between the two terms. Last edited 9 October 2026 at the time of the record.

## Why It Matters

I looked it up in May 2026 when [[aoife-brennan]] and I were talking about how the welfare role weighs on whoever holds it. I knew the idea from community nursing. Welfare officers carry things they cannot share, which is a different load from the busy-volunteer kind of [[volunteer-burnout]]. It is one more reason for a deputy ([[welfare-officer-needs-a-deputy]]) and for the chair to check in on the welfare officer as a person, without ever asking about cases.

## Caveats

About professional carers and trauma work; a club welfare role is far lighter. I do not use it to judge anyone's wellbeing.
